title: One Journey or Circle can be listed across member Spaces and partner Collectives
detail:
PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on event sharing. Dated after Founding Collective launch.

Owners request Journey or Circle listings with active member Spaces or partner Collectives; only receiving owners approve, and either side can revoke. Destination readers merge accepted listings without changing original ownership, price, entry, enrolment or edit access. Visibility, lifecycle, source transfers and owner changes invalidate stale consent. Owner UI previews original subjects and remains able to remove listings after cancellation. CLI-generated migration068 is service-only with real subject foreign keys, uniqueness and cascades. Full typecheck, focused consent/store/UI/reader tests, actual SQL behavior and committed authorization assertions pass. Production migration068 is applied and canonically registered; browser table/RPC access is denied, existing Space/Journey/Circle counts are preserved, and exact production-generated table/RPC types are integrated.

Final independent-main proof on 3f1502de: full 8GB typecheck passed; 65 targeted store/actions/reader/UI tests pass, shipped-process probe exercises 1201-subject and selector inventories, preserves original Space/access and surfaces stale DB write refusal. Migration068 locks subject/Space consent writes and returns one authorized subject snapshot, permanently revokes canonical owner/source/parent transfers and safely revokes lost profile authority. Committed isolated-engine actual SQL fixture passes 33 consequences both with and without the canonical Space-owner FK (66 assertions); no multi-connection concurrency or live SQL application is claimed. Source grants/schema/client/admin checks pass. Approved migration068 passed the full62-suite/1024-assertion replay and production permissions verification; this integrates Journey/Circle listings, not event/calendar shares.
